queryCondition.queryText:
EmailEvents
| where EmailDirection == "Intra-org"
| where ThreatTypes has_any ("Phish", "Malware")
| summarize Recipients = dcount(RecipientEmailAddress), Messages = count(), Subjects = make_set(Subject, 8), ReportId = take_any(ReportId), Timestamp = min(Timestamp) by SenderFromAddress
| where Recipients >= 3

alertTemplate.title: Compromised internal sender spreading phishing
alertTemplate.description: An internal mailbox sent Phish/Malware to 3 or more colleagues - a strong account-takeover signal being weaponised for lateral phishing.
alertTemplate.recommendedActions: Treat the sender as compromised: reset credentials, revoke sessions, review inbox rules and OAuth grants, and ZAP/purge the malicious messages from all recipients.
